task_completion.description: A tiddler titled exactly 'Quote Explorer' is created and open in the wiki.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler with the heading 'Quote Explorer' is visible in the TiddlyWiki story river.

task_completion.description: The Analytics Section displays dynamic counts for Total Quotes, Starred Quotes, and Total Authors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Numerical values (e.g., '10', '0') are visible next to labels like 'Total Quotes', 'Starred Quotes', and 'Total Authors' within the dashboard.

task_completion.description: The Main Explorer Section lists quotes with their text, author, and source fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list or table showing multiple quote entries, each displaying text content, an author name, and a source.

task_completion.description: Each quote in the explorer has an interactive checkbox to toggle the 'Starred' tag.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Checkboxes are visible next to each quote entry in the Main Explorer list.

task_completion.description: A 'Starred Quotes' heading exists and dynamically displays quotes tagged with both 'Quote' and 'Starred'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A section titled 'Starred Quotes' is visible; when a checkbox in the explorer is clicked, that quote appears in this section.

task_completion.description: The dashboard uses reactive widgets (<$count>, <$list>, <$checkbox>) to manage data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The counts and the shortlist update immediately when a checkbox is toggled without a page refresh.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the TiddlyWiki edit interface, typing into the tiddler body, and clicking the 'save' (checkmark) button.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the numbers (e.g., '10') but used widgets to calculate them.
integrity.visual_evidence: If the agent toggles a checkbox, the 'Starred Quotes' count in the Analytics section should change dynamically.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the pre-seeded quotes tagged 'Quote'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The list in the 'Quote Explorer' displays the actual text of the seeded quotes (e.g., historical quotes) rather than placeholder text.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target tiddler must be titled 'Quote Explorer'. The wiki contains 10 pre-seeded quotes tagged 'Quote'. The agent must use the following TiddlyWiki widgets: <$count> for the analytics, <$list> for the explorer and shortlist, and <$checkbox> for the starring functionality. The 'Starred' tag is the specific tag used for the interactive toggle.
